answers.core: This is about the core rendering capabilities.
answers.workaround:
It can be resolved by adding a tween which would change the alpha value of the modulation and remove when finished. This would achieve the same visual effect. However, tweens would run on CPU, and creating a large number of tweens can negate the performance benefit of removing old decals.

This can be also achieved with using particles however particles wouldn't conform to surfaces like decals.
